description: Check a number you are about to state, or one a user has stated, against DraftCall data for one player: points per game, games played, bye week, positional rank, or any season stat such as rushingYards or receptions. Returns whether the figure matches and the actual value when it does not. Use this before quoting a figure from memory, and whenever a user asserts a stat.

metric.description: Which figure to check. ppg is points per game in scoring_format; rank is positional rank; the rest are season totals.

scoring_format.description: Scoring format. ppr awards 1 point per reception, half_ppr 0.5, standard 0. Defaults to half_ppr, the most common league setting.

name: verify_claim

actual.description: The real figure, or null when DraftCall holds none.

claimed.description: The figure that was submitted for checking.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

scoring_format.description: The format the figure was checked in, or null for metrics that do not vary by format.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

verdict.description: unknown means the claim could be neither confirmed nor corrected, not that it was wrong.

title: Check a stated figure against DraftCall data
